reproduction: Open the original app and confirm both Reset Range prompts before selecting a course. Browser harness reproduces the exception.
cause: The handler dereferences grade controls before buildGradeUI has created them.
fix: Disable Reset until a course has records; also guard the handler. Provide Undo instead of two confirmation prompts.
verification: Browser regression: reset is disabled on initial load; reset after invalid edits restores valid boundaries and export.

issue: Duplicate course options within one upload
reproduction: Import the boundary fixture: four records belonging to Course A. The original creates four Course A options.
cause: The upload handler adds an option for every record without deduplication.
fix: Build the course list from a Set of validated course names.
verification: Browser regression: the same four-record XLSX produces exactly one course option.

reproduction: Import the Course A fixture, then the one-record Course B fixture. Original options include four Course A entries plus Course B.
cause: The upload handler appends options and replaces data without resetting dependent UI state.
fix: A successful import atomically replaces data and dependent state only in the selected institute workspace. Failed imports retain its previous valid workbook with an explicit notice.
verification: Browser regression: replacement leaves only Course B and updates its average to 65. Invalid replacement preserves the previous four valid records.

issue: Minimum and maximum displayed under swapped labels
reproduction: Import marks 0, 20, 80 and 100. Original browser output reads Min 100 and Max 0.
cause: The Min label contains the max element ID; the Max label contains the min element ID.
fix: Render correctly named minimum and maximum fields from the shared statistics function.
verification: Browser regression: Min 0, Max 100, mean 50 and median 50. Core tests independently check the expected values.

reproduction: Set A maximum to 99, or E minimum to 1, in the original. Validation reports no error and export stays enabled even with boundary-mark students.
cause: Validation checks adjacent bands but does not require the outer endpoints to be 100 and 0.
fix: Validate complete 0-100 coverage in the core and at export time; lock the outer endpoint controls in the UI.
verification: Core tests reject either missing endpoint, gaps and overlaps. Browser regression verifies locked endpoints and blocked invalid exports. All 101 integer marks are checked across defaults and 500 valid partitions.

issue: Valid single-mark grade band is rejected
reproduction: Set A to 100-100 and A- maximum to 99. Original validation rejects the otherwise continuous ranges.
cause: The condition min >= max disallows equality, although ranges are inclusive and marks are whole numbers.
fix: Allow equal minimum and maximum while preserving continuity, ordering and endpoint checks.
verification: Core tests assign 100 to A and 99 to A-. Browser regression accepts the single-mark band and updates its adjacent maximum.

reproduction: After importing marks, choose the blank course option in the original. Mean and median become NaN, and export remains enabled with valid ranges.
cause: Statistics divide by zero and index an empty array; export enablement depends only on range validity.
fix: Return explicit null statistics for empty data and render dashes. Require records, valid ranges and a nonblank instructor for export.
verification: Core empty-data test and initial browser empty-state check pass. Browser checks verify export blocking with no instructor and after clearing the instructor.

issue: File picker advertises only .xls despite .xlsx requirement
reproduction: Inspect the original file input: accept is .xls. The challenge specifies .xlsx workbooks.
cause: The HTML accept attribute names only the legacy extension.
fix: Accept .xlsx and .xls, validate the file signature and parse the workbook with a pinned local Excel reader.
verification: Native file selection imports the four-record boundary XLSX. Browser regression rejects corrupt input. The actual downloaded CSV was reopened and all four expected IDs, marks and grades were verified.
